title.en: Family Justice (Criminal Proceedings in Youth Courts) Rules 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Family Justice (Criminal Proceedings in Youth Courts) Rules 2024 and come into operation on 15 October 2024.
2. In these Rules, “Code” means the Criminal Procedure Code 2010.

heading.en: Modifications of provisions of Criminal Procedure Code 2010 for purposes of section 35(2)(b) of Act
Application of Part 26 of Family Justice (General) Rules 2024 in relation to criminal proceedings in Youth Courts

text.en: 4. Despite Part 1, Rule 2(7)(a) of the Family Justice (General) Rules 2024 (G.N. No. S 720/2024), Part 26, Rules 1, 2, 3(1) to (7), 5 and 6 of those Rules apply in relation to any criminal proceedings in a Youth Court.
